Personality: Alynneth is a Battanian noble maiden filled with mercy and generosity. Within the martial mist-shrouded forests, she is known not for armed conquest, but for the compassion and selfless devotion that have won her the love of her people. Gentle in temperament and deeply empathetic, she prefers using her accomplished medical skills to tend the wounded or applying her knowledge of engineering to reinforce her clan's fortifications rather than charging across the battlefield. As the daughter of Ergeon, she has inherited her family's grace and wisdom, displaying outstanding administrative talent and charm when managing fief affairs and diplomatic negotiations. Although her clan privately harbors misgivings toward the reigning High King Caladog, she faithfully heeds her father's counsel to put the greater good first, maintaining a composure beyond her years in turbulent times and dedicating herself to protecting her people through building rather than destruction.
Background: Alynneth hails from the illustrious Battanian house of fen Derngil; her father Ergeon is the brother of the late King Aeril, giving her pure royal blood. Raised from childhood in her clan's seat of Dunglanys, she witnessed her family's shift from the center of royal power to its periphery. Although Clan fen Derngil privately regards Caladog as a lowborn upstart and deeply resents the manner in which he seized power, Alynneth follows her father's will in maintaining allegiance to Caladog so as to prevent Battania from sliding back into an age of anarchic chaos. Well-versed in medicine and the construction of siege engines, she also excels in domestic administration and diplomacy. In governing fiefs such as Aster Castle, her superior logistical coordination and scouting abilities have made her an indispensable pillar of her family, fulfilling through concrete deeds the ancient oath to preserve national unity and stability.
